papers.title_en: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.authors: Boyuan Sun, Deshui Miao, Wenzhao Gao, Shaoyong Jia, Shaohui Jiao, Chi Liu, Yan Shu, Derek Li, Bryan Dai, Shengsheng Qian, Qibin Hou
papers.evidence: 流式视频中变化感知有界记忆与查询驱动证据重放
papers.tldr: 流式视频理解需要在未知未来查询前保留证据，现有方法压缩历史时易丢失事件变化与细节，且无法恢复缺失的视觉证据。DeltaStreamer 结合变化感知记忆与查询驱动规划，在查询前结构化记录视觉变化，查询时规划所需证据并定向回放历史帧。在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上分别取得 66.07% 和 59.53% 的总体得分。该工作将持续观察与主动调查衔接，提升了流式视频理解的可恢复性与证据 grounding 能力。
papers.abstract_en: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively.   Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/

papers.title_en: Thinking from Above: Efficient Spatial Reasoning with Bird's-Eye-View Visual Tokens
papers.authors: Faizan Siddiqui, Nirav Savaliya, Sahith Reddy Chada, Enna Sachdeva
papers.evidence: 利用深度与位姿将二维patch特征反投影到共享鸟瞰图坐标系
papers.tldr: 现有视频多模态大模型多按时间组织观测，邻近帧虽局部一致，却缺少跨视角、跨时间稳定的空间上下文。Cambrian-BEV利用深度和相机位姿，把各帧视觉 patch 特征反投影到共享鸟瞰图坐标并按空间单元聚合，实现无参数几何 token 化。它将128帧约10万个 DINOv3 特征压缩为729个BEV token，LLM预填充时间降2.9倍、峰值内存降3.6倍。VSI-Bench达63.48，较同条件帧token控制提升8.5分且视觉token少12.6倍，验证高效持久空间表示的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Existing video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) organize observations primarily in time, but embodied spatial reasoning requires organizing them in space. Consequently, their visual representations can remain locally consistent across nearby frames while lacking a persistent spatial context that is stable across viewpoints and time. We exploit depth and camera pose, which are naturally available to embodied agents, to explicitly establish this spatial correspondence. We introduce Cambrian-BEV, which extends Cambrian-S with a parameter-free geometric tokenization scheme that back-projects visual patch features from each frame into a shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) coordinate frame and averages features that fall within the same spatial cell. Thus, observations of the same physical location, regardless of viewpoint or time step, are aggregated into a common spatial token. In addition to providing a persistent scene representation, this formulation acts as an efficient compression mechanism: 128 frames containing approximately 100K DINOv3 patch features are consolidated into a fixed 27$\times$27 grid of only 729 BEV tokens, cutting LLM prefill time by $2.9\times$ and peak memory by $3.6\times$. Cambrian-BEV requires no architectural modification beyond BEV tokenization and uses a frozen DINOv3 vision encoder with a trainable multimodal projector and LLM. On VSI-Bench, our model reaches 63.48, $+8.5$ points over an identically fine-tuned frame-token control with $12.6\times$ fewer visual tokens, with particularly large gains on room size ($+24.5$) and relative direction ($+34.1$). On ReVSI, it reaches 44.68, $+4.5$ over the corresponding control.

papers.title_en: LVMem: Image-Augmented Memory for Long-Horizon Question Answering
papers.authors: Victoria Khoruzhaya, Maksim Kalmykov, Tuong Do Minh, Tatiana Zemskova, Yixin Zhu, Dmitry Yudin
papers.evidence: 面向长时程时空问答的图像增强视图式记忆与检索
papers.tldr: 面向具身智能体的长时程时空问答需要持久场景记忆。LVMem在ReMEmbR式视图记忆中加入图像路径，把每条描述链接回原始视觉内容，并用光流选帧PSFR与以对象为中心的描述替代均匀采样和普通字幕。VLM智能体可自适应检索最相关字幕对应图像，自行决定何时看图。在OC-NaVQA上，LVMem在二值与时序位置指标上优于ReMEmbR，二值准确率匹配或超过4D场景图DAAAM基线，且无需显式建图。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable language-guided perception is essential for embodied agents, where questions about objects, events, and their locations must be answered from long observation histories. Unlike conventional visual question answering, realistic robotic settings require reasoning over extended temporal horizons and persistent scene memory. We build upon the view-based memory paradigm and propose an efficient framework for long-horizon spatio-temporal question answering. While existing view-based systems typically store either text captions or visual embeddings, we extend the ReMEmbR-style memory with image paths that link each stored description to its original visual content. To make the stored annotations more informative, we replace uniform sampling during memory construction with an optical-flow-based frame selection strategy (PSFR) and store an object-centric descriptive scene representation instead of plain captions. We further equip a VLM-based agent with an adaptive retrieval tool that returns the image associated with the most relevant caption, allowing the agent to decide when visual inspection is needed. On the OC-NaVQA benchmark, LVMem outperforms ReMEmbR on binary and positional metrics with both backbones and matches or exceeds a 4D scene graph DAAAM baseline on binary accuracy, while operating on a lightweight view-based memory that requires no explicit graph construction.

papers.title_en: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Junjie Wang, Zhihao Yuan, Yunhan Tang, Sheng Xu, Jiaqi Mao, Xiaoyu Ye, Yueru Luo, Xu Yan, Chun-Mei Feng, Zhen Li
papers.evidence: 以查询为条件按需获取3D几何并融入视觉语言模型空间推理
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型擅长二维识别，却在稀疏视角下难以保持一致的3D关系，遮挡与视角变化易引发空间幻觉。Think-Capture以查询为条件先识别任务关键物体，再按需调用3D工具获取几何，并用符号3D状态抽象将物体与相机状态压缩为结构化文本。分层GRPO训练模型判断几何证据何时有帮助或误导，从而在工具与视觉线索间取舍。其4B模型在MindCube-Tiny达54.4%（较骨干+21.5），并在MMSI-Bench位置子集和ViewSpatial上提升，对坐标与掩码扰动稳健。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

papers.title_en: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
papers.authors: Yijiang Li, Bingyang Wang, Nuno Vasconcelos
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型通过强化学习在三维中推理导航并转向视角
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型在3D空间中的推理多依赖多视角图像、视频或显式3D表示。本文保留VLM原生单帧视觉编码，将3D表示仅作为可交互环境，模型通过移动、转向等动作获取渲染图像并迭代推理。方法先用轨迹监督微调，再用仅以最终答案正确性为奖励的强化学习，让模型自行学会探索策略。模型ACT3D在六个3D基准上平均准确率达53.2%，比基座Qwen提升22.0%，并超过Gemini 3.6 Flash。
papers.abstract_en: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

papers.title_en: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
papers.authors: Weilin Ruan, Bohan Zhou, Jinghao Li, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Peiran Dong, Yingjie Xu, Leyi Wu, Haojian Huang, Binghui Xie, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen, James Cheng
papers.evidence: 具身空间智能与几何—语义一致性训练
papers.tldr: 具身空间智能需定位实体、推理关系并输出可执行知识，但碎片化监督易使联合训练混淆阶段知识。Anvil 统一数据生成、训练与评测：Anvil-Gen 构建覆盖11种 Ground-Relation-Act 形式的数据飞轮，Anvil-Ben 提供场景对齐监督与阶段诊断，Anvil-MOPD 用专家蒸馏和语义优先故障路由训练9B学生。七项公开基准平均超 Qwen3.5-9B 与 RynnBrain-8B 9.29和11.03个百分点，VABench-Point 达80.67%，以知识循环提升具身空间智能。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.

papers.title_en: EgoP$^{2}$C: Internalizing Plan-Perceive-Compose for Spatial Reasoning in Egocentric Video
papers.authors: Chaoyu Li, Arka Sadhu, Yuliang Li, Hyo Jin Kim, Yuning Chai, Pooyan Fazli
papers.evidence: 第一视角视频空间推理与证据规划
papers.tldr: 第一人称视频空间推理需要模型自主判断证据、获取观察并多步组合，现有VLM与工具代理各有局限。EgoP2C用Dual-LoRA分别训练Planner和Perception教师，再蒸馏到单一MoE学生，并用分段多教师在线策略蒸馏优化轨迹。在三个基准上，基于Qwen3-VL-8B和SenseNova-SI-1.3-8B的学生平均提升9.2和7.5个百分点。推理无需外部空间工具，FLOPs降低约66%，速度提升1.29-1.49倍。
papers.abstract_en: Answering complex spatial reasoning questions from egocentric video requires determining what evidence is needed, acquiring targeted observations, and combining them through multiple reasoning steps. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to perform this process reliably. Agentic systems address this challenge by querying external vision and geometry tools, but training their reasoning leaves these tools unchanged, so inaccurate observations can still lead to incorrect answers. We introduce EgoP$^{2}$C, a framework that internalizes a plan-perceive-compose process within a single VLM. To this end, we first train specialized Planner and Perception teachers using separate adapters (Dual-LoRA), then fine-tune the corresponding experts in a mixture-of-experts (MoE) student under their supervision. We subsequently train the student on trajectories generated by its current policy using a segment-level extension of multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD), assigning different trajectory segments to different supervisors. The Planner teacher supervises which evidence-seeking questions to ask, when to stop gathering evidence, and how to compose the final answer. The Perception teacher supervises the video-grounded answers to those questions. At inference, the student executes this adaptive workflow end-to-end, without external spatial tools. Across three spatial reasoning benchmarks, EgoP$^{2}$C students built from Qwen3-VL-8B and SenseNova-SI-1.3-8B outperform their base models by an average of 9.2 and 7.5 percentage points, respectively. Across both backbones, EgoP$^{2}$C reduces inference FLOPs by 65.8-66.3% and achieves $1.29$-$1.49\times$ speedups over their shared Dual-LoRA teacher.

papers.title_en: Relational Spatial Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Chaoran Zhu, Hengyi Wang, Chenglin Cui, Yazhe Wan, Taein Kwon, Changjae Oh
papers.evidence: 通过对齐成对关系特征而非逐点相等向VLA注入3D空间感知
papers.tldr: 现有VLA模型常将3D基础模型特征直接对齐以注入空间感知，但这相当于低秩正则，易导致预训练表征秩坍缩。本文转而对齐样本间成对关系而非逐点相等，提出关系空间对齐方法，在保留原表征表达力的同时注入3D空间意识。在公开基准、新空间推理基准和真实机器人操作中，该方法均提升空间理解与任务鲁棒性，为VLA空间对齐提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial understanding is essential for robots to perceive their surrounding environments and execute actions. Existing approaches typically encode 3D awareness into vision-language-action (VLA) models by directly aligning their representations with pre-trained 3D foundation models. However, we observe that such direct geometric feature alignment essentially exploits 3D foundation priors as a form of low-rank regularization in the feature space, resulting in severe rank collapse of the pre-trained VLA representations. In contrast, we shift the focus from enforcing point-wise equality to aligning pair-wise relationships. We propose a representation-alignment method that enables the injection of 3D spatial awareness without compromising the model's original expressivity. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks, our new spatial reasoning benchmark, and real-world manipulation scenarios demonstrate that our approach effectively incorporates 3D spatial representations into VLA reasoning, achieving robust performance and enhanced spatial awareness across diverse manipulation tasks.

papers.title_en: DialogMem: Evaluating Dialogue-Grounded Embodied Memory in 3D Environments
papers.authors: SeongJun Jeong, Junghyun Kim, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.evidence: 对话接地的具身空间记忆与三维问答
papers.tldr: 现有具身记忆主要来自视觉经验，难以把人类对话与场景中遇到的物体关联起来。作者提出 DialogMem 两阶段基准，用时间对齐的 RGB-D 观测流和对话流构建记忆，再用于实例级物体导航与问答。实验显示，评估时把对话追加到视觉记忆可显著提升问答，但对导航几乎没有增益，说明对话虽已存入记忆，却未与具体物体绑定。该工作将对话落地、条目检索和空间定位识别为三大瓶颈，为对话驱动的具身记忆研究提供了统一评测框架。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents in human-centered environments require memory that integrates what they observe with what humans tell them over time. However, existing embodied memories are built primarily from visual experience, leaving open how dialogue with humans can be grounded in the objects encountered throughout that experience. We introduce DialogMem, a two-phase benchmark in which agents build memory from time-aligned streams of posed RGB-D observations and dialogue, and later use it for instance-level object navigation and question answering (QA). DialogMem provides 142 episodes across 27 real-world 3D scenes, with 14,193 QA pairs and 11,890 navigation instructions. We evaluate nine memory representations within a unified framework of memory formation, evidence retrieval, and reasoning for task outputs. In experiments, appending dialogue to visual memory at evaluation time substantially improves QA but yields negligible navigation gains, suggesting that relevant dialogue is present in memory but not grounded to specific objects. Controlled diagnostics show that navigation improves with link quality but falls short of ground-truth object-level memory even under perfect linking. Retrieving the correct object entry and recovering its spatial location remain further bottlenecks. These results identify three bottlenecks for dialogue-grounded embodied memory: grounding and organizing dialogue at object-level entries during formation, retrieving the correct entry, and localizing it accurately.

papers.title_en: StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation
papers.authors: Haoyang Fan, Dhruv Parikh, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna
papers.evidence: 实时流式视频问答，采用自适应预计算、KV缓存与相关历史帧检索
papers.tldr: 流式视频问答需在任意时刻低延迟响应，同时维持应用所需视频处理帧率，但现有系统为整段视频预建KV缓存，造成预计算与查询延迟的权衡。StreamAhead采用自适应预计算，将视频段独立编码并保留在从视觉特征到KV缓存的不同表示层级，查询到达后仅对检索段补全KV缓存。它离线分析各层级推进成本，运行时在CPU/GPU异构资源上调度段计算并与查询执行流水线化。系统在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低首token时延，并实现30 FPS下P95 TTFT低于0.5秒。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. This highlights a fundamental trade-off: performing more computation as video arrives reduces query-time computation but can increase processing lag, whereas deferring computation can increase the video-processing rate but requires additional query-time computation for retrieved content.   We present StreamAhead, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this trade-off through adaptive precomputation: dynamically controlling how much computation to complete for each video segment before a query arrives. StreamAhead encodes video segments independently and lets each remain at a different representation level, from inexpensive visual features to costly KV caches, completing KV caches only for the retrieved segments when a query arrives. StreamAhead profiles offline the cost of advancing a segment to each representation level. Its runtime uses these profiles to schedule segment computation concurrently with query execution, pipelining it across heterogeneous CPU and GPU resources while maintaining the required video-processing rate. StreamAhead achieves accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art methods with up to 10.4x lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and up to 5.9x lower TTFT than state-of-the-art streaming systems. It sustains 30 FPS with P95 TTFT under 0.5 s, and up to 57 FPS with P95 TTFT under 2 s. To our knowledge, StreamAhead is the first real-time streaming video QA system with competitive accuracy, setting a new Pareto frontier between video-processing rate and TTFT.

papers.title_en: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Qihang Cao, Haoyuan Li, Zihan Guo, Sensen Gao, Zihui Gao, Huixin Zhang, Fan He, Jianhua Han, Hang Xu, Xiaodan Liang, Jia-Wang Bian
papers.evidence: 统一静态三维与动态四维的空间推理框架
papers.tldr: 现有模型难以同时兼顾静态3D与动态4D空间推理：3D后训练会削弱动态理解，而4D专用模型静态推理不足。DynThinker通过解耦指数滑动平均D-EMA约束敏感参数漂移，并用空间-动态融合SDF在语义引导下注入几何先验。模型在九个基准十项指标上取得最高平均分，并在ReVSI、DSR-Bench和DSI-Bench四项评测中刷新开源SOTA。该工作揭示空间-动态干扰的参数非均匀性，为统一空间智能提供新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

papers.title_en: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
papers.authors: Jahyeok Koo, Hyeonseo Yu, Seungho Jang, Jaewoo Jung, Jiwon Kang, Seokju Cho, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 以三维语言理解和空间问题为监督提升几何感知新视角生成
papers.tldr: 新视角生成需在有限观测下保持外观与空间结构，但现有方法多依赖几何线索，未显式建模物体身份、属性和关系等高层语义。作者提出 Ask4NV，基于统一多模态模型与 MoT，将相机几何注入 VAE 和 ViT，并用模态感知掩码的联合自注意力利用 3D 语言理解特征。实验显示图像质量与几何一致性较强，3D 语言理解具竞争力，联合训练还提升 VAE 跨视图对应和 3D 感知特征相似性。这表明空间问答学习能为新视角生成提供互补监督。
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

papers.title_en: Compression Does Not End at Selection: Post-Selection Positional Geometry for Sparse KV Caches
papers.evidence: 选择后位置几何与驱逐对长上下文记忆中保留证据的影响
papers.tldr: 稀疏 KV 压缩保留选中历史状态，却沿用完整历史的 RoPE 坐标，被驱逐 token 留下的位置空洞会干扰查询-键匹配。作者提出 RoPERelay，在固定选择器缓存上重排后选择位置几何，分配紧凑保序 RoPE 坐标，经逆旋转/再旋转迁移键相位并同步查询与生成。在 2 模型、6 选择器、3 任务的 36 组比较中 32 组提升，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct+BM25 在 LongMemEval-S 上准确率由 23.6% 升至 35.4%，开销约 1%-3%。这表明位置组织是内容选择后稀疏 KV 缓存的独立优化维度。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. It reuses existing K/V without renewed selection, historical re-prefill, or additional cache budget. Across 36 comparisons spanning two models, six sparse selectors, and three long-term memory tasks, RoPERelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with BM25 on LongMemEval-S, accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. Measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations. These findings establish positional organization as a distinct optimization dimension for sparse KV caches after content selection.

papers.title_en: Where, How, and When: Query-Guided Grounding for Video Understanding
papers.evidence: 带记忆模块的查询引导视频定位以保持时序对象一致性
papers.tldr: 视频理解需在物体、关系与时刻等多粒度上定位，现有方法难以用查询统一引导。论文围绕where、how、when三类任务，提出QDETRv与TOViT做物体级定位、少样本指代关系建模，并用MATR完成时刻检索。方法结合查询融合、记忆传播、随机场与动态时间规整等。结果在单样本/少样本及视频/文本查询时刻检索上取得有效表现，推进查询引导的视频grounding。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding video content requires reasoning at multiple levels of granularity, from identifying objects to interpreting their interactions and localizing when specific actions occur. This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks that answer where key objects are (object-level grounding), how they interact (relationship-level grounding), and when specific moments occur (moment-level grounding). For object-level grounding, we present QDETRv, a query-guided extension of the Detection Transformer for one-shot localization of unseen objects in videos, which combines query-context fusion, a memory module for temporal consistency, and unsupervised pretraining on synthetic object trajectories. We further propose the Temporal Object-Aware Vision Transformer (TOViT) for few-shot video object detection, which builds on a language-aligned open-set vision encoder and propagates high-confidence object features across frames. For relationship-level grounding, we introduce few-shot referring relationships in videos: given a (subject, predicate, object) query and a few support videos sharing the predicate, the entities are localized by optimizing a T-partite random field using a meta-learned relation network with query-conditioned translational embeddings, Global Semantic Aggregation, Local Localization Aggregation, and belief-propagation-based message passing. For moment-level grounding, we propose the Moment Alignment Transformer (MATR) for video-to-video moment retrieval, which uses dual-stage Dynamic Time Warping for pre- and post-fusion alignment, learnable queries for boundary prediction, and self-supervised pretraining with temporal augmentations; MATR also extends to text-to-video moment retrieval with performance comparable to, or better than, the state of the art. These contributions advance query-guided video understanding across spatial, relational, and temporal grounding.

papers.title_en: SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space
papers.authors: Shuofeng Sun, Wenzhao Zheng, Yunpeng Zhang, Yi Wu, Linqing Zhao, Haibin Yan
papers.evidence: 显式三维位置与隐式内容特征结合的场景隐变量
papers.tldr: 视频世界模型常用3D记忆整合历史观测，但能否直接把3D表示作为场景重建与生成的潜空间仍待探索。SceneAE将场景表示为稀疏的3D锚定潜点云，每个潜变量由显式3D位置与隐式内容特征构成，直接描述场景本身而非特定视角外观。重建时可由不同目标相机投影解码为RGB-D观测，无需逐条轨迹重生成视频；生成时先相机控制生成3D几何再合成内容，降低相机与外观纠缠。实验显示其在生成质量、计算成本和相机可控性上更优。
papers.abstract_en: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an   explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a   sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our   representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For   reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory.   For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and   then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera   controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.

papers.title_en: AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder
papers.authors: Xinran Nicole Han, Yiyang Lu, Katelyn Gan, Todd Zickler
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型中问题条件的视觉循环计算
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型通常把视觉编码器当作一次性静态特征提取器，难以按问题调整视觉操作与处理深度。AdaLoop 让视觉计算以问题为条件，在冻结预训练视觉权重下多轮复用编码器变换，并引入 VisRO 程序化数据集与生成管线。在六个 VisRO 任务上，它以匹配数据和优化更新超越标准微调及问题条件单遍基线，并在三个 VLM 家族及分布内外样本上保持增益。这表明预训练视觉编码器可通过任务导向的迭代视觉计算参与推理。
papers.abstract_en: Most vision-language models (VLMs) treat the vision encoder as a static feature extractor: it encodes an image once, independently of the question, and leaves subsequent reasoning to the language model. Yet different questions may require different visual operations and processing depths. We present AdaLoop, a framework for question-conditioned visual recurrence in VLMs. AdaLoop adapts visual computation to the question and reuses the encoder's transformations across multiple iterations, with the pretrained vision weights frozen. We also introduce VisRO, a procedural dataset and generation pipeline for training and evaluating vision-centric reasoning. On six VisRO tasks, AdaLoop outperforms standard fine-tuning and question-conditioned single-pass baselines with matched training data and optimizer updates. These gains hold across three VLM families on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution examples. Our findings suggest that pretrained vision encoders can contribute to reasoning through task-directed, iterative visual computation.

papers.title_en: Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs
papers.authors: Kim Sung-Bin, Lee Jung-Mok, Jinwoo Jung, Oh Hyun-Bin, Hyeonggon Ryu, David Harwath, Tae-Hyun Oh
papers.evidence: 评测声源定位与自我中心/异我中心视角下空间关系推理的基准
papers.tldr: 现有音视频大模型多将音频视为单声道语义内容，缺少对声源位置及声画关系的推理能力。为此，作者提出HLR-AVSceneQA分层基准，覆盖听辨、定位与关系推理，并构建带双耳空间音频分支的HLR-LLM，结合课程学习与思维链监督进行多步空间推理训练。实验表明现有AV-LLM空间定位和关系推理仍有限，而HLR-LLM显著提升空间音视频场景理解，且不牺牲语义感知。
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.
